name: Polaris USDp
oneLiner: USDp (formerly pUSD) is Polaris's pre-launch Liquity-style CDP stablecoin minted against pETH; a Stability Pool routes interest and liquidations to holders.
collateral: pETH / ETH-derived collateral posted in Polaris CDPs, with protocol revenue and liquidation flows routed to USDp Stability Pool participants rather than offchain reserve yield
pegMechanism: Pre-launch Liquity-style CDP stablecoin: borrowers post pETH collateral to mint USDp, undercollateralized positions are liquidated through a Stability Pool, and USDp holders can earn borrower-interest and liquidation-flow yield once runtime sources are live
launchPhaseDetail: Public testnet open on Sepolia at testnet.polaris.finance (the earlier app.testnet.polarisfinance.io host no longer resolves); official documentation is live at docs.polaris.finance. Polaris has moved from polarisfinance.io to polaris.finance (currently a coming-soon page linking the testnet, docs, and @polarisfnd), took its earlier blog offline, and now brands the asset USDp rather than pUSD. Security review in progress with professional audits upcoming per the former polarisfinance.io roadmap; mainnet date uncommitted: the former site stated no date was set and prioritised security over speed, so the earlier 2026-Q4 expectation was retired on 2026-08-05. A $1M angel round with Ethereum Foundation, Liquity, LI.FI, Altitude, and Fusion participation was reported on September 4 2026, without a mainnet date.

featuredContent.title: pUSD: No Counterparty, No Ceiling
featuredContent.description: How USDp (then pUSD) delivers counterparty-free yield that scales alongside protocol adoption and the developing ecosystem supporting it.

featuredContent.title: Sustaining the Ecosystem: pETH & pUSD Flows
featuredContent.description: Polaris replaces emission-based incentives with an autonomous protocol-revenue distribution mechanism that flows to participants based on their asset holdings: no governance-driven allocation, no bribery.

featuredContent.title: The Path to the North Star
featuredContent.description: TokenBrice traces Polaris's origins from Robert Lauko's bonding-curve research to today's three-pillar mission: counterparty-free yield, ETH-correlated alternatives, and restoring DeFi credibility against a backdrop where only $184.79M of the $338.9B stablecoin supply is non-freezable.

featuredContent.title: USDp - Polaris Documentation
featuredContent.description: Official reference for the native Polaris dollar: collateral, minimum collateral ratio, and the Earn Vault.

milestones.title: Polaris introduces self-scaling stablecoin operating system
milestones.description: Three-token model (pETH, pUSD, POLAR) with immutable code design and uncorrelated yield from protocol revenues; pUSD has since been renamed USDp.

milestones.title: 'Sustaining the Ecosystem: pETH & pUSD Flows' published
milestones.description: Documents Polaris's autonomous protocol-revenue distribution mechanism routing borrower interest and liquidation flows to USDp (then pUSD) Stability Pool participants by holdings.

milestones.title: TokenBrice publishes 'The Path to the North Star' founder narrative
milestones.description: Long-form post outlining Polaris's three-pillar mission (counterparty-free yield, ETH-correlated yield alternatives, restoring DeFi credibility) and tracing the protocol's lineage to Robert Lauko's bonding-curve research; mainnet timeline still uncommitted.

milestones.title: Polaris documentation renames pUSD to USDp
milestones.description: The official docs at docs.polaris.finance describe USDp as the native Polaris dollar (115% minimum collateral ratio, pETH collateral, Earn Vault), and the Sepolia testnet app at testnet.polaris.finance uses the USDp label throughout. The docs repository was created on June 8 2026 and its diagrams switched to USDp wording on June 22; the earlier Polaris blog posts used pUSD.

milestones.title: Polaris closes $1M angel round with Ethereum Foundation, Liquity, and LI.FI participation
milestones.description: Polaris reported a $1 million angel round joined by the Ethereum Foundation, Fusion (IPOR), Altitude, Liquity, LI.FI, and more than 30 founders and contributors including Anthony Sassano, to build pETH as yield-bearing collateral for USDp and GOLDp. No mainnet date accompanied the round, and the Polaris blog carried no post about it.
